results.description:
This is a 3d skull scan for a Tech theater class lecture.  The scan will be reproduced by 3d printing as a prop for future stage shows.

These scans are a work in progress. The team will regularly update the gallery, models, and scans as this project progresses. Thanks for checking out the art, photogrammetry, and scans.

results.name: Skylar Breeze, a casual summer character scan
results.description: Skylar Breeze captures an easy, candid moment—a relaxed stance, hands on hips, half-turned smile, and the kind of posture that feels more real than posed. Dressed in a fitted light-blue summer dress with subtle texture detailing, white sneakers, and dark-framed glasses, she reads as contemporary and approachable without losing visual clarity in silhouette. The model balances realism with clean presentation, making it suitable for modern game environments, VR social spaces, crowd systems, or fashion/lifestyle visualization. Works especially well in daylight scenes and grounded urban or casual interior settings.
